home.description: A focused collection of everyday web tools. Open a tool, process the input, copy the result, and keep one-off tasks in the browser.
home.aboutDescription: Turinhub Toolbox is an open source project for simple, efficient, ad-free online tools. Most tools run in the browser; AI, S3, FTP, or API testing tools may use browser network requests, server proxies, or third-party services. You can inspect the code on GitHub or deploy it locally.

tools.title: Online Tools
tools.description: Turinhub Toolbox collects free, ad-free, mostly local-first tools for development, text processing, design, networking, AI assistance, and everyday calculations.

domainChecker.inputDescription: Accepts domains, HTTP / HTTPS URLs, subdomains, and internationalized domains.
domainChecker.inputHint: Domains default to HTTPS. URLs retain their protocol, port, path, and query; fragments are ignored.
domainChecker.empty: Enter a domain or URL and start a check to see results.
domainChecker.partialDone: Check complete. Some results are incomplete; review the individual notices.
domainChecker.failed: Could not complete the check. Try again later.
domainChecker.copyFailed: Could not copy. Check your browser clipboard permissions.
domainChecker.dnsNote: A DNS address does not prove that a website is reachable or a domain is available to register.
domainChecker.noRecords: No DNS records were retrieved for this domain.
domainChecker.dnsPartial: Could not complete these record types: {types}. Other results are retained.
domainChecker.subject: Certificate subject
domainChecker.sslNote: Certificates are checked for the input hostname. HTTP URLs additionally check port 443; HTTPS URLs use the input port. Validity requires a trusted chain, matching hostname, and valid dates.
domainChecker.registrationNote: Uses public RDAP data. Subdomains are queried up to the registration domain. Missing or redacted data does not establish registration availability. Some suffixes are unsupported.
domainChecker.httpNote: Requests originate from this server. Timing includes DNS, connections, and redirects, rather than browser page load time. Unsupported HEAD requests fall back to GET, reading headers only. Follows up to 5 redirects.
domainChecker.headersNote: Checks header presence only, not policy strength. Missing headers do not establish that a website is unsafe.
domainChecker.helpDescription: DNS, certificates, HTTP, and registration checks run independently and retain partial results. Only public domain targets are allowed. URLs must not contain credentials. Registration uses RDAP; traditional TCP Whois fallback is not provided.

errors.invalidInput: Enter a valid domain or HTTP / HTTPS URL, such as https://example.com.
errors.unsupportedProtocol: Only HTTP and HTTPS are supported. Change the URL protocol.
errors.credentialsNotAllowed: Remove the username and password from the URL and try again.
errors.humanVerificationRequired: Return to the homepage to complete human verification, then retry the check.
errors.blockedAddress: The target resolves to a private, loopback, or reserved address. Use a public domain.
errors.dnsFailed: DNS queries failed or partially timed out. Try again later.
errors.dnsNotFound: No DNS records found. Check the domain or try again later.
errors.timeout: The query timed out. Try again later.
errors.networkFailed: The network connection failed. Check the target or try again later.
errors.invalidResponse: The source returned unparseable data. Try again later.
errors.certificateInvalid: Certificate chain, hostname, or validity verification failed. Check the certificate configuration.
errors.redirectLoop: A redirect loop was detected. Check the website redirect configuration.
errors.tooManyRedirects: Stopped after 5 redirects. Check the website redirect configuration.
errors.registrationUnsupported: No authoritative RDAP endpoint is available for this suffix. Check Whois with the registry.
errors.registrationNotFound: No registration record found. Check the domain; this does not establish availability.
errors.rateLimited: The registration endpoint is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
